On this page

Corporate functions depend on both technical accuracy and coordination across the organisation. A finance position, HR appointment and administrative role have different outputs and stakeholders. Define the function’s actual responsibilities, the systems used and the decisions the person will be expected to make.

For finance-related roles, explain the reporting environment and relevant qualifications or employer requirements. For HR and administration, identify the processes and organisational scale involved. Roles with regulatory or professional eligibility requirements must have those criteria confirmed by the employer before selection.
Function, reporting line and decision scope
Relevant systems and qualifications
Sector experience and employer eligibility criteria
Location, compensation and selection process
What should a corporate recruitment brief prioritise?
Prioritise the function’s responsibilities, expected outputs, systems and reporting line. Include mandatory qualifications and any employer-defined professional eligibility requirements.

Recruitment for Education & Professional Services
Adult instructor guiding professional trainees in a classroom

Education and professional-service organisations recruit for a range of instructional, administrative and specialist roles. The brief should explain the audience or client group, the services delivered and the responsibilities assigned to the position. This helps distinguish subject expertise from coordination or operational support.

For teaching or training requirements, specify the subject, learner level and qualifications expected by the employer. For professional-service roles, identify the domain, client-facing responsibilities and relevant systems. Any professional authorisation or destination-specific eligibility should be confirmed through the appropriate channels.
Subject area or professional-service domain
Required qualifications and relevant experience
Learner or client context and responsibilities
Employer eligibility and assessment criteria
How should education or training roles be described?
Specify the subject, learner level, teaching or coordination responsibilities and required qualifications. Include employer eligibility criteria and the intended assessment process.

Engineering & Technical Recruitment | Adhuni HR Solutions
Recruitment support for engineering and technical roles, with screening shaped around discipline, equipment experience and project requirements.
Recruitment for Engineering & Technical

Engineering appointments need a precise understanding of the discipline and the environment in which the work will be done. Design, installation, commissioning and maintenance can require different experience even when the job title is similar. Begin with the responsibility the role will own and the technical outcomes expected.

Specify the systems, drawings, tools or standards relevant to the assignment. Clarify whether the candidate will work independently, supervise a team or support a wider engineering function. Where assessments or credentials are required, identify them in the brief rather than relying on general descriptions such as “experienced engineer”.
Engineering discipline and project phase
Relevant equipment and system experience
Qualifications and assessment requirements
Site conditions, reporting line and joining date
How should we define an engineering recruitment requirement?
Specify the discipline, project phase, systems or equipment involved, essential qualifications and scope of responsibility. Include assessment requirements and the working environment.

Recruitment for Facilities Management
Facilities technicians inspecting equipment in a building plant room

Facilities teams support the everyday operation of buildings and sites. Requirements differ between technical maintenance and wider support services, so the brief should identify the asset type and the work included. Adhuni supports recruitment discussions around these practical responsibilities and the employer’s service expectations.

For technical roles, describe the building systems involved and whether the work is preventive maintenance, fault response or coordination. For support functions, clarify coverage hours, service standards and supervision. State site-access expectations and any role-specific qualifications that must be checked.
Building or site type and service scope
Systems experience and maintenance responsibilities
Coverage hours and response expectations
Required qualifications and reporting arrangements
What is needed for a facilities-management hiring brief?
Identify the building or site, systems, service scope and coverage hours. Separate technical maintenance requirements from support roles and define the supervision involved.

Hospitality Recruitment | Adhuni HR Solutions

Recruitment for Hospitality
Contemporary restaurant dining room prepared for guest service

Hospitality hiring begins with the service environment. A restaurant, hotel front desk and housekeeping operation require different day-to-day capabilities. Describe the guest experience your team is expected to deliver and the responsibilities of each role so candidates can be reviewed against practical requirements.

Include the property or outlet type, shift pattern and any relevant language or system requirements. Explain the level of guest contact and whether a role includes supervision, cash handling or food service responsibilities. Proposed working conditions and benefits should be clear before candidates are considered.
Property or outlet type and service standards
Guest-facing responsibilities and languages
Shift arrangements and reporting relationships
Required experience, benefits and joining date
What should a hospitality hiring brief explain?
Specify the property or outlet, guest-service responsibilities, required experience, shift pattern and relevant language or system skills. Include compensation and benefits.

Information Technology Recruitment | Adhuni HR Solutions
Recruitment for Information Technology

Technology recruitment benefits from a clear distinction between the role’s core responsibilities and a long list of tools. Explain whether the person will support users, maintain infrastructure, administer applications or contribute specialist technical expertise. The working environment gives the skills list its meaning.

Identify the platforms that are essential, the level of ownership expected and the problems the role should be able to handle. State any on-call requirements and the stakeholders involved. Agree how technical capability will be assessed so candidates receive a consistent and relevant selection process.
Core responsibilities and technical environment
Essential platforms and depth of experience
Support hours, on-call duties and location
Technical assessment and interview criteria
How specific should an IT hiring requirement be?
State the core responsibilities, essential platforms and level of ownership. Separate mandatory skills from useful extras and explain how technical capability will be evaluated.
Recruitment for Logistics & Supply Chain

Supply-chain teams connect suppliers, stock and delivery schedules. The right brief explains the part of that flow a role will own. Warehouse operations, inventory control and procurement may share information, but each requires a different balance of systems knowledge, coordination and practical experience.

Describe the operation’s scale, product handling requirements and relevant warehouse or enterprise systems. Clarify whether the role is hands-on, administrative or supervisory. Include shift patterns, reporting responsibilities and any mandatory equipment authorisations or qualifications specified by the employer.
Warehouse or supply-chain responsibilities
Relevant systems and handling requirements
Shift pattern, location and team structure
Essential experience and role-specific credentials
Which details help define a logistics recruitment brief?
Explain the operation, responsibilities, systems, shifts and product-handling requirements. Specify whether the position is hands-on, administrative or supervisory.

Retail & E-commerce Recruitment | Adhuni HR Solutions
Recruitment for Retail & E-commerce

Retail and e-commerce hiring spans different customer journeys. A store associate may focus on direct service and sales, while an online operations role may coordinate orders, stock and customer queries. Define where the position sits and the tasks it will handle each day.

Describe the product category, customer-service expectations and systems used. For store roles, include trading hours, shift patterns and cash-handling responsibilities where relevant. For e-commerce roles, identify the platforms, order volumes or fulfilment activities that shape the work, without assuming all experience is interchangeable.
Store or online operating model
Customer-service and sales responsibilities
Relevant systems and product knowledge
Working hours, location and team requirements
Can retail and online operations be included in one enquiry?
Yes. Give each role its own responsibilities, quantities and required experience. Distinguish customer-facing store work from online order, inventory and fulfilment activities.

Our Recruitment Approach & Process | Adhuni HR Solutions
See how Adhuni recruits in five steps, from hiring brief and candidate search to screening, interviews and joining, with one contact keeping you updated.

The forms ask for contact details and the information relevant to your hiring requirement, career profile or general enquiry. Candidates can provide qualifications, experience, skills, passport status and an optional CV. General enquiries can include an optional attachment. Please do not send passport scans, identity numbers or unrelated sensitive information.

Enquiries and optional attachments are sent to the company’s configured email recipient to respond to the request. Candidate information may be shared with relevant employers for recruitment purposes. Uploaded files are processed for email delivery; this website does not create a candidate account or a separate CV database. Email delivery uses Resend and spam protection uses Cloudflare Turnstile. Hosting and these service providers may process technical information needed to deliver and protect the service.
